introduction: Nvidia Corporation was incorporated in California in April 1993 and re-incorporated in Delaware in April 1998. The company pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computing problems. The company's two main businesses — GPU and Tegra processors — are based on a single underlying architecture. Nvidia has a platform strategy that brings together hardware, system software, programmable algorithms, libraries, systems and services to create unique value for the market it serves.
